source_cn:
小丑们涌了过来，有的表演踩马车轮子不倒，有的匍匐于巨大的皮球上，有的往天空扔出一个个网球，又以滑稽的动作一一接住。
　　梅丽莎看着这些表演，神情沉静地就像对方并不存在，班森努力了几次，并大声喝彩，可都没能调动起妹妹的情绪，自己也慢慢低沉。
　　克莱恩紧抿嘴唇，远远望着这一幕，想要靠近却又不敢。
　　忽然，他摸了下衣兜里的钱夹，有了一个想法。
　　班森和梅丽莎继续前行，沉默地观看着各种表演。
　　过了一阵，他们看到一个涂着红黄白等各色油彩的小丑跑了过来，先是往天上扔出一个个网球，接着在人们的注意力被吸引到半空时，不知从哪里变出了一束花，一束塞维亚菊。
　　这束花凑到了梅丽莎和班森眼前，颜色金黄，象征着快乐。
　　梅丽莎和班森略显茫然地望向对面的小丑，只见他满是红黄白等各色油彩的脸上，嘴角高高翘起，固定着一个快乐的笑容，浮夸的笑容，滑稽的笑容。

　　——第一卷《小丑》第二百一十三章 再看一眼
ref_en:
Clowns swarmed over, some performing by stepping on carriage wheels without falling, some crawling on huge leather balls, some throwing tennis balls into the sky, and catching them one by one with funny movements. 
 Melissa watched these performances, her expression as calm as if the other party didn’t exist. Benson tried several times and cheered loudly, but couldn’t stir up his sister’s emotions, and he himself slowly became depressed. 
 Klein pursed his lips, watching this scene from afar, wanting to approach but not daring to. 
 Suddenly, he touched the wallet in his pocket and had an idea. 
 Benson and Melissa continued to move forward, watching various performances in silence. 
 After a while, they saw a clown painted with red, yellow, white, and other oil paints run over, first throwing tennis balls into the sky, and then when people’s attention was attracted to the air, he produced a bouquet of flowers from nowhere, a bouquet of Zinnia. 
 This bouquet was brought to Melissa and Benson’s eyes, golden in color, symbolizing happiness. 
 Melissa and Benson looked at the clown opposite with a slightly dazed look, only to see the corners of his mouth, which was full of red, yellow, white, and other oil paints, raised high, fixing a happy smile, an exaggerated smile, a funny smile. 
 
 —— Volume 1: Clown, Chapter 213: Take Another Look

source_cn:
%s:
      我听闻你与子爵夫人遭遇了一场苦战。不必过分担忧。在过去的岁月循环中，我已经明白失败与胜利——乃至生存与死亡——都不过是一时的、相对的：它只是你旅途中的一个普通坐标，用来验证你的成长。谨记面对子爵夫人的诀窍：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302123">子爵夫人的记载</>
      对于一位总在路上的旅人来说，我知道让人停下脚步的常常并非挫折本身，而是失去了再次上路的勇气。所幸你并不胆怯于面对更多新冒险，我想下次，我听到的就会是更好的消息。对你这样年轻的非凡者而言，你已经做得很好。
      如果你需要的话，漫长的时光为我积淀下一些经验，也许对你有用。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s:
      I heard you had a bitter struggle with the Viscountess. Do not worry too much. In the cycles of the past, I have come to understand that failure and victory—and even life and death—are merely temporary and relative: they are just ordinary coordinates on your journey, used to verify your growth. Keep in mind the trick to facing the Viscountess: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302123">Record of the Viscountess</>
      For a traveler who is always on the road, I know that what often makes people stop is not the setback itself, but the loss of courage to set off again. Fortunately, you are not timid about facing more new adventures. I think next time, what I hear will be better news. For a young Beyonder like you, you have already done very well. 
      If you need it, the long passage of time has accumulated some experience for me, which might be useful to you. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

<Assistant_Title2>玩法规则：</>①达到参与条件的玩家组队前往<Assistant_Red>霍纳奇斯花海萨默尔太太处</>，由队长发起结成誓约邀请。②被邀请方接受邀请后进入互相书写誓言流程。③书写完誓言后双方互相交换查看收下对方的誓言，进入拍婚纱照流程。④双方选择拍照模版，最终确认后完成拍照流程，双方结成誓约关系。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Covenant System】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Description: </><Assistant_System>Covenant System</> is a social gameplay where two players who are friends form a team, go to Mrs. Sammer to apply for a covenant relationship, and then participate in team activities together to earn Covenant Points and Companion Emblems. 
<Assistant_Title2>Participation Requirements: </>① Both parties must reach <Assistant_Red>Level 30</> to unlock the Covenant System. ② Both parties must be friends and have a <Assistant_Red>Friendship Level of 200 points</>. 
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Rules: </>① Players who meet the requirements form a team and go to <Assistant_Red>Mrs. Sammer in the Hornacis Sea of Flowers</>, where the captain initiates the covenant invitation. ② After the invitee accepts, they enter the process of writing vows to each other. ③ After writing the vows, both parties exchange, view, and accept each other's vows, then enter the wedding photo process. ④ Both parties select a photo template, and after final confirmation, the photo process is completed, and the two parties form a covenant relationship.

ref_en: You are entrusted with delivering a new book to Mr. Moon. Upon arriving at Golden Autumn Lake, you stumble upon a young girl in a heated argument with her mother over her obsession with 'vampires'—as a series of 'Dracula's Bride' murders have occurred locally. You find Mr. Moon at the cemetery, where he immediately reveals the truth: the so-called vampires are merely human monsters corrupted by potions, using romance novels to lure girls to their deaths. The real culprit is hiding in a coffin in the cemetery. After you defeat the murderer, Mr. Moon continues his pursuit of the 'Abundance Corruption', leaving you alone to deal with the fanatical follower.

准备好了。“审判官”从教会偷来了“机械之灵核心”，先藏在炼钢工厂，就等着仪式启动。他现在喜欢称我为“主人”，他说等我晋升成功，就能重塑肉体，成为半神，到时候他就是我的首席打手。
　　我把核心握在手里，凉得刺骨。
　　为了这个，死了很多人，包括警队内部的兄弟，安迪、老柯林、小玛莎……
　　那一刻我突然想问自己：值得吗？
　　但答案没有意义了，已经走得太远，没法回头了。
ref_en:
Ready. The "Inquisitor" stole the "Core of Mechanical Spirit" from the church and hid it in the steel mill, just waiting for the ritual to start. He now likes to call me "Master"; he says that once I successfully advance, I can reshape my body and become a Demigod, and by then he will be my chief enforcer. 
 I held the core in my hand; it was bone-chillingly cold. 
 For this, many people died, including brothers within the police force, Andy, Old Colin, Little Martha... 
 At that moment, I suddenly wanted to ask myself: Is it worth it? 
 But the answer is meaningless; I have already gone too far and cannot turn back.

source_cn:
罗塞尔四处征战，成就大帝之名，同时曾作为知识皇帝的他，收集了有关战争的历史，其中最为庞杂丰富的便是第四纪的四皇之战。
在罗塞尔大帝陨落之后，祂的知识与意志并未消散，而是与王冠结合，成为了知识王冠。其中蕴含着最为丰富的一处知识，承载着祂对"四皇之战"的全部记忆——那些血与火的岁月、征服与被征服的史诗、王朝兴衰的轨迹，被知识皇冠的光芒永久镌刻。
末日降临，母神的威胁逼近，祂影响了知识皇冠让其权柄自行运转，以知识带来"创造"，于是，一个前所未有的存在诞生了——
「战略服」，一个由罗塞尔的战争记忆与知识皇冠的历史推演能力，共同编织的平行空间集合体。
"战略服，等你入局。"
ref_en:
Roselle fought everywhere, achieving the name of Great Emperor. At the same time, as the Knowledge Emperor, he collected history related to war, the most complex and rich of which was the War of the Four Emperors in the Fourth Epoch.
After the fall of Emperor Roselle, His knowledge and will did not dissipate, but combined with the crown to become the Knowledge Crown. It contains the richest piece of knowledge, carrying all His memories of the "War of the Four Emperors"—those years of blood and fire, the epics of conquering and being conquered, and the trajectories of the rise and fall of dynasties were permanently engraved by the light of the Knowledge Crown.
The apocalypse descended, and the threat of the Mother Goddess approached. She influenced the Knowledge Crown to make its authority operate on its own, bringing "creation" through knowledge. Thus, an unprecedented existence was born—
"Strategic Server", a collection of parallel spaces woven together by Roselle's war memories and the historical deduction ability of the Knowledge Crown.
"Strategic Server, waiting for you to enter the game."

当目标玩家的理智值<Highlight>低于一定值</>时，即可对其发起安魂。

安魂的<Highlight>治疗成功率</>取决于两个因素：安魂者所在<Highlight>社团的等级</>，以及被安魂者当前的<Highlight>理智值高低</>。社团等级越高、对方理智值越高，安魂成功的概率也越高。

需要注意的是，安魂并非没有风险——<Highlight>若安魂失败</>，参与双方的理智值均有概率受到波动，产生一定损耗。
ref_en:
When the target player's Sanity <Highlight>is below a certain value</>, you can initiate Purification on them. 

The <Highlight>healing success rate</> of Purification depends on two factors: the level of the <Highlight>Club</> the Purifier belongs to, and the current <Highlight>Sanity</> level of the person being purified. The higher the Club level and the higher the other person's Sanity, the higher the probability of a successful Purification. 

It should be noted that Purification is not without risk—<Highlight>if Purification fails</>, both participating parties have a chance to experience Sanity fluctuations, resulting in a certain loss.

source_cn: ……古弗萨克语的“知识”一词，词根可追溯至更古老的时代，原意为“背负”。在古弗萨克人的观念中，知识不是财富，是需要背负的东西。本书试图考证这一词根在语族中的流变，然而材料有限，迄今未能得出确凿结论。\n　　这一发现本身就值得深思。在多数文明的隐喻中，知识被比作光、比作水、比作可以囤积的财货。而古弗萨克人选择了另一个意象：负重。
ref_en: ...The root of the word "knowledge" in the ancient Futhark language can be traced back to an even older era, originally meaning "to carry on one's back." In the worldview of the ancient Futhark people, knowledge was not wealth; it was something that needed to be carried. This book attempts to examine the evolution of this root within the language family, yet materials are limited, and no definitive conclusion has been reached to date. \n　　This discovery itself is worth pondering. In the metaphors of most civilizations, knowledge is compared to light, water, or goods that can be stockpiled. The ancient Futhark people, however, chose a different image: bearing a burden.

source_cn:
<Assistant_Title1>【足迹追寻】</>
<Assistant_Title2>介绍：</>
你的视觉将暂时剥离于现实的表象。灵性与此地沉淀的历史孔隙产生短暂的共鸣。你的眼前，将浮现出这片土地最有魅力的时刻。
<Assistant_Title2>玩法指引</>
<Assistant_Title3>1.进入玩法</>
可通过以下方式前往【足迹追寻】：
<Assistant_Property2>跑团入口：</>打开菜单进入【跑团】，加入任一教团后，在【秩序世界】中选择玩法【足迹追寻】，选中点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Property1>地图入口：</>打开地图，切换至【探秘】页签，在【世界详情】中查看【足迹追寻】玩法图标，并根据图标指引，在地图中找到对应标识，点击【前往】即可自动寻路。
<Assistant_Title3>2.完成交互</>
到达目标地点后，根据提示选择【观景】，欣赏这片土地最具美丽的景观之一并拍照留念。
<Assistant_Title3>3.解锁记忆</>
完成交互后，完成对应记忆的探索，增加所在地图的完成度。
ref_en:
<Assistant_Title1>【Footprint Tracking】</>
<Assistant_Title2>Introduction:</>
Your vision will temporarily detach from the surface of reality. Your spirituality will resonate briefly with the historical gaps settled in this place. Before your eyes, the most charming moments of this land will emerge.
<Assistant_Title2>Gameplay Guide</>
<Assistant_Title3>1. Enter the Gameplay</>
You can head to [Footprint Tracking] via the following methods:
<Assistant_Property2>TRPG Entrance:</>Open the Menu, enter [TRPG], join any Covenant, select the [Footprint Tracking] gameplay in the [Order World], and click [Go] to initiate Dowsing Rod Navigation.
<Assistant_Property1>Map Entrance:</>Open the map, switch to the [Exploration] tab, view the [Footprint Tracking] gameplay icon in [World Details], find the corresponding marker on the map based on the icon's guidance, and click [Go] to initiate Dowsing Rod Navigation.
<Assistant_Title3>2. Complete Interaction</>
Upon arriving at the target location, follow the prompts to select [View] to appreciate one of the most beautiful landscapes of this land and take a photo as a souvenir.
<Assistant_Title3>3. Unlock Memories</>
After completing the interaction, finish the exploration of the corresponding memory to increase the completion rate of the current map.

“在成为值夜者之前，我的梦想是做一位画家。”弗莱的语气没有一点起伏。
　　“那为什么不去实现梦想呢？”克莱恩疑惑问道。
　　弗莱放好铅笔，手拿燕尾服小丑的肖像道：
　　“我的父亲是女神的牧师，希望我也成为一名牧师，这是足够体面的职业。”
　　“你做过牧师？”克莱恩愕然再问。
　　他很难想象弗莱这种性格这种气质的人做牧师。
　　“嗯，做得还不坏。”弗莱表情冷漠，嘴角隐有点上翘地回答道，“后来遇见了一些事情，经历了一些事情，就成为值夜者了。”

　　——第一卷《小丑》第七十八章 心理阴影
ref_en:
"Before becoming a Nighthawk, my dream was to be a painter." Frye's tone had no fluctuations at all. 
 "Then why not realize your dream?" Klein asked in confusion. 
 Frye put away his pencil and held the portrait of the tailcoat clown: 
 "My father was a priest of the Goddess and hoped that I would also become a priest. It's a decent enough profession." 
 "You were a priest?" Klein asked again in astonishment. 
 He found it hard to imagine someone with Frye's personality and temperament being a priest. 
 "Hmm, and I wasn't bad at it." Frye replied with a cold expression and a slightly upturned corner of his mouth, "Later, I encountered some things, experienced some things, and became a Nighthawk." 
 
 —— Volume 1 "Clown", Chapter 78, Psychological Shadow

塔罗学派成员可以通过“密契仪式”，调整自己身心灵的状态，提升与“屏障碎片”中不同领域能力的契合程度，形成自己的“密契非凡觉醒”，增强自身各项非凡能力。

但这种方式也蕴含着污染和风险。除了与自身非凡途径原本就契合的一个“密契领域”之外，每位非凡者还最多可以额外密契另一个领域。选择发展不同的“密契非凡天赋”，对相应领域能力的掌握也会有所不同。
ref_en:
The "Barrier Fragments" sealed by "The Fool" with the gray fog in the Tarot Club contain the residual power of the "Original" Creator—that is, Beyonder powers from nine different domains. 

 Tarot Club members can use the "Mystic Rite" to adjust their body, mind, and spirit, increasing their compatibility with the different domain powers in the "Barrier Fragments" to form their own "Mystic Beyonder Awakening" and enhance their various Beyonder abilities. 

 However, this method also carries corruption and risks. In addition to the one "Mystic Domain" that is naturally compatible with their own Beyonder pathway, each Beyonder can additionally mysticize at most one other domain. Choosing to develop different "Mystic Beyonder Talents" will result in different levels of mastery over the corresponding domain's abilities.

<Highlight>开启次数累计：</>从周一开始时，每日新增并累积共享开启次数，直到下周一重置。具体规则如下：

1-5次：消耗<Highlight>20</>活力；
6-10次：消耗<Highlight>50</>活力；
11-20次：消耗<Highlight>100</>活力；
21-30次：消耗<Highlight>150</>活力；
30次以后：消耗<Highlight>200</>活力。
ref_en:
<Highlight>Secret Treasure Opening Count Sharing: </>World Adventure Secret Treasure, War-Nurturing Secret Treasure, and Social Gift Treasure Chest share the opening count. 
<Highlight>Opening Count Accumulation: </>Starting from Monday, new shared opening counts are added and accumulated daily until they reset the following Monday. The specific rules are as follows: 
1. From Monday to Friday, <Highlight>10</> shared opening counts are added and accumulated daily; 
2. Starting from the second week of the server opening, there is no limit on Saturday and Sunday; 
3. On Friday, Saturday, and Sunday of the first week of the server opening, <Highlight>10</> shared opening counts will still be added and accumulated daily. 
4. Secret treasures that have been obtained but not opened can be manually discarded after unlocking new secret treasures. 

<Highlight>Opening Vitality Consumption: </>The vitality consumed by shared opening counts will increase as the number of times the Beyonder has opened them increases. The specific rules are as follows: 
1-5 times: consume <Highlight>20</> vitality; 
6-10 times: consume <Highlight>50</> vitality; 
11-20 times: consume <Highlight>100</> vitality; 
21-30 times: consume <Highlight>150</> vitality; 
After 30 times: consume <Highlight>200</> vitality.

source_cn:
我是罗塞尔·古斯塔夫，但我要记得我真正的姓名——黄涛。
        这封日记写于我自己的陵墓中，现在的我既没有活着、也没有死去，只是偶尔会获得短暂的清醒。我似乎迷失了很久，只能一遍又一遍回想我挂念的那些东西，让我不要真的被疯狂与污染控制。
        可笑的是，我曾经拼命搏来的那些荣誉，什么蒸汽机、狗屎蒸汽之子，这些原本就不属于我的东西对稳定认知一点用都没有，只会反噬我。
        我这辈子真正挂念的，是我的孩子们……
        夏尔，算算时间他应该已经去世了。死亡是一份礼物，希望他能作为普通人去度过幸福的一生。这是我们其他所有人都无法获得的平静……
        博诺瓦……该死的蒸汽与机械之神，别让我逮到你！还有查拉图和“门”，等我复活了，我绝对一个个上门好好拜访！我的孩子应当肆意自由地活着，而不是成为神明的傀儡！不知道他那纯粹的神性中，有没有那么一点对我这个父亲的爱……一点点就够了。
        心爱的贝尔纳黛，应验了查拉图的预言，她终究憎恨、厌弃和离开了我。不知道我被刺杀后她怎么样了……
        头开始疼了，那家伙的呓语声真是难听。我又得睡了，我不会将这份污染带到这个世界上，这里还有我想守护的东西。哈哈，就跟我一起被封印在这里吧！
        但我终会归来，只要我的子民还在信仰我，只要我留下的文明与规则没有消逝，只要这个世界还有人记得我的名字……连归来的口号我都想好了——因蒂斯的子民们，你们的皇帝回来了！
        但在又一次的沉眠前，我似乎看到了一些被我遗忘了许久的东西……炸鸡、可乐、游戏机、家，和好像老去了一些的爸妈……
        那是或许平凡乏味但再也回不去的人生。
        故乡啊……
ref_en:
I am Roselle Gustav, but I must remember my real name—Huang Tao. 
 This diary was written in my own mausoleum. Right now, I am neither alive nor dead; I only occasionally gain brief moments of clarity. I seem to have been lost for a long time, and I can only recall the things I care about over and over again so that I am not truly controlled by madness and corruption. 
 It is ridiculous that the honors I once fought for, all that steam engine stuff, that bullshit Son of Steam, these things that never belonged to me are of no use in stabilizing my cognition and will only backfire on me. 
 What I truly care about in this life are my children... 
 Charles, calculating the time, he should have passed away by now. Death is a gift; I hope he can spend a happy life as an ordinary person. This is the peace that none of the rest of us can obtain... 
 Bernadette... damn God of Steam and Machinery, don't let me catch you! And Zaratul and the "Door," once I am resurrected, I will definitely visit each of you! My children should live freely and wantonly, not become puppets of the gods! I don't know if there is even a little bit of love for me, their father, in that pure divinity of his... a little bit is enough. 
 Beloved Bernadette, the prophecy of Zaratul has come true; she eventually hated, abandoned, and left me. I don't know how she is after I was assassinated... 
 My head is starting to hurt; that guy's gibberish is really unpleasant. I have to sleep again. I will not bring this corruption into this world; there are still things I want to protect here. Haha, just be sealed here with me! 
 But I will eventually return, as long as my people still believe in me, as long as the civilization and rules I left behind have not faded, as long as there is still someone in this world who remembers my name... I have even thought of the slogan for my return—Citizens of Intis, your Emperor has returned! 
 But before falling into another slumber, I seem to have seen some things I had forgotten for a long time... fried chicken, cola, game consoles, home, and my parents who seem to have aged a bit... 
 That is a life that might have been ordinary and dull but can never be returned to. 
 Hometown...

source_cn:
感谢您那日陪我完成这趟奇特的旅程。不瞒您说，我至今仍觉得周身萦绕着那罐头的味道，怕是好几天都散不掉。
　　但您猜怎么着？女儿看了那些照片，笑得前仰后合。她终于愿意跟我聊聊天了——虽然多半是在笑话我，但至少，我们又说上话了。 
　　她还给我布置了个新任务：把正版《大冒险家》从头到尾读一遍，再写篇读后感交给她。 
　　另外，那天在码头遇见的后援会朋友邀我们参加下次的活动。女儿听说后，竟说“一起去看看”。我想，这或许是个不错的开始。

又及：那些照片我还留着。每次看到，都觉得……来都来了，总得留点什么。
ref_en:
Thank you for accompanying me on this peculiar journey that day. To be honest, I still feel the smell of those canned goods lingering around me; I'm afraid it won't dissipate for several days.
	But guess what? My daughter looked at those photos and laughed until she was doubled over. She is finally willing to chat with me—although mostly to make fun of me, at least we are talking again. 
	She even gave me a new Quest: read the original "Great Adventurer" from beginning to end and write a review for her. 
	Also, the friend from the fan club I met at the Dock that day invited us to participate in the next event. When my daughter heard about it, she actually said, "Let's go take a look together." I think this might be a good start.

P.S.: I still have those photos. Every time I see them, I feel... since I've already come, I must leave something behind.

source_cn:
弗莱并不是一个话多的人，也不喜欢凑热闹，连爱好也是待在角落安静地画画。
他曾经梦想成为一位画家，过一种安稳平凡的生活。
不过后来，他听从家人的建议，成为了一位体面的牧师，做得还不赖。
再后来，他加入了黑荆棘，成为了序列9的收尸人。
明明也算充满波澜的人生，但在他的叙述中，这一切平淡得像一杯温水——或者说，冷水。

作为一名“收尸人”，他皮肤苍白，气质阴冷，少言少笑，日常工作是和尸体打交道，天然难让人产生亲近感，但相处久了才知道，他会在克莱恩害怕尸体的时候，默默给他练习的机会；他会在伦纳德迟到的时候，帮他打掩护；他会在任务结束后，默默帮队友善后。
他很少说什么，但每次有人需要帮助的时候，他永远在。

这个想法一直延续到弗莱成为队长后。
“我想留在黑荆棘，一直保护这里。”
就这样，他拒绝了继续晋升，拒绝了远行，选择留在熟悉的佐特兰街36号，除了日常出任务外，偶尔还会画几张画。
在他的画里，所有离开的人都不曾离开，并且各自有一个不错的结局：邓恩队长终于鼓起勇气向戴莉女士告白，老尼尔与恋人为他们弹琴祝贺，克莱恩完成了一个非常赚钱的委托，伦纳德写出了人生中第一首诗，洛耀西迦科恩黎罗珊在研究一种新的四人方块牌，据说也来自罗塞尔大帝，叫什么斗麻雀……
而他弗莱，则在角落里，安静地画着这些瞬间。
在这个疯狂的世界里，不是每个人都想要成为传奇，有的人只是想守着一方天地，静静度过每一天。
ref_en:
Frye is not a talkative person, nor does he like to join in the fun; even his hobby is staying in a corner and painting quietly. 
 He once dreamed of becoming a painter and living a stable and ordinary life. 
 But later, he followed his family's advice and became a decent priest, and he wasn't bad at it. 
 Later still, he joined Blackthorn and became a Sequence 9 Corpse Collector. 
 Although it could be considered a life full of ups and downs, in his narration, everything was as plain as a cup of warm water—or rather, cold water. 
 
 As a "Corpse Collector," he is pale, cold, and quiet. His daily work involves dealing with corpses, which naturally makes it hard for people to feel close to him. But after spending time with him, you realize that when Klein is afraid of corpses, he silently gives him opportunities to practice; when Leonard is late, he helps him cover; and after a mission, he silently helps his teammates clean up. 
 He rarely says anything, but whenever someone needs help, he is always there. 
 
 This thought continued until Frye became captain. 
 "I want to stay at Blackthorn and always protect this place." 
 Just like that, he refused further promotion, refused to travel far, and chose to stay at 36 Zoutland Street. Besides his daily missions, he would occasionally paint a few pictures. 
 In his paintings, all those who left never really left, and each had a good ending: Captain Dunn finally gathered the courage to confess to Ms. Daly, Old Neil played the piano for them with his lover, Klein completed a very profitable commission, Leonard wrote the first poem of his life, and Luo Yao, Xiga, Cohen, and Rosanne were studying a new four-person block game, which was said to also come from Emperor Roselle and was called something like Mahjong... 
 And he, Frye, was in the corner, quietly painting these moments. 
 In this crazy world, not everyone wants to be a legend; some people just want to guard a piece of heaven and earth and spend every day quietly.

source_cn: 我站在“黑王座号”的船头，张开双臂，对格林和爱德华兹他们说：“想要我的财宝吗？那就到迷雾海的尽头来寻找吧，我将所有的财宝都藏在了这里！”\n        但他们完全不懂我的幽默，竟然问我是不是真的有额外的财宝。真是无趣啊，你们这样是做不了我的天启四骑士的！但他们依旧愿意追随我在那片充满迷雾的海洋里冒险。\n        我一直在想，北大陆西边是迷雾海，东面是苏尼亚海，我怀疑这两大海洋的尽头还有别的大陆，就像狂暴海的尽头是南大陆一样，说不定我能发现一个全新的大陆，西大陆！
ref_en: I stood at the bow of the "Black Throne," spread my arms, and said to Green, Edwards, and the others, "Do you want my treasure? Then go find it at the end of the Fog Sea; I have hidden all my treasure there!" \n But they completely failed to understand my humor and actually asked if I really had extra treasure. How boring; you guys can't be my Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse like this! But they are still willing to follow me on adventures in that ocean full of fog. \n I have been thinking, to the west of the Northern Continent is the Fog Sea, and to the east is the Sonia Sea. I suspect that there are other continents at the ends of these two great oceans, just like the end of the Berserk Sea is the Southern Continent. Maybe I can discover a brand new continent, the Western Continent!

source_cn:
%s，好久不见：
      我听说了你最近与西尔维娅艰辛的交战。辛苦了，你一直都很努力。我和苏茜搜集了一些有关西尔维娅的情报，希望能有所帮助：<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302108">西尔维娅的记载</>
      你所承受的命运写满了未知与危险，连我们也无法勘破你身上的迷雾和谜团。未来或许还有更多的险境、更大的危机在等待着我们。我们都需要变得更强，才能保护好自己和珍视的事物。但当你疲惫的时候，欢迎随时来命运咖啡厅坐坐，我这里有不错的红茶和糕点，或许你会喜欢。闲暇的时候，可以来陪我和苏茜聊聊天，让心态平和下来，一切都会好起来的。
      不用担心，我和其他人都会尽力帮助你，随信附上一些提升实力的建议。<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">点此查看</>
ref_en:
%s, long time no see: 
      I heard about your recent arduous battle with Sylvia. You've worked hard; you have always been very diligent. Susie and I have gathered some intelligence regarding Sylvia, and I hope it proves helpful: <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1302108">Records of Sylvia</>
      The fate you bear is filled with unknowns and dangers; even we cannot pierce through the mist and mysteries surrounding you. Perhaps more perilous situations and greater crises await us in the future. We all need to become stronger to protect ourselves and the things we cherish. But when you are exhausted, you are always welcome to come to the Fate Café for a seat. I have some excellent black tea and pastries here that you might enjoy. In your spare time, feel free to come chat with Susie and me to calm your mind; everything will be alright. 
      Do not worry; I and the others will do our best to help you. Attached to this letter are some suggestions for improving your strength. <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="jump=1250207">Click here to view</>

source_cn: 【廷根旧梦】为限时结交人脉活动。 活动期间，克莱恩·莫雷蒂结交概率大幅提升。当获得传说人脉时，80%概率为克莱恩·莫雷蒂。如果本次结交的传说人脉不是克莱恩·莫雷蒂，则下次结交获得传说人脉时必定为克莱恩·莫雷蒂。 概率信息</> <Highlight>[传说]</>品质人脉：基础概率为1.5%，综合概率（含保底）为3.74% 包含：克莱恩·莫雷蒂、奥黛丽·霍尔、伦纳德·米切尔、佛尔思·沃尔、邓恩·史密斯、戴莉·西蒙妮、阿尔杰·威尔逊 <Highlight>[史诗]</>品质人脉：基础概率为10%，综合概率（含保底）为22.56% 包含：苏茜、洛薇雅·蒂芙尼、老尼尔、弗莱、弗兰克·李、班森·莫雷蒂、梅丽莎·莫雷蒂 <Highlight>[常规道具]相关</>：基础概率为88.5%，综合概率（含保底）为73.70% 包含：基础物质、聚合因子 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>结交细则</> 1、每5次结交，必定获得一位史诗或以上的人脉。 2、如果连续24次结交未获得传说人脉，则后续概率逐渐提升。 每40次结交必定获得传说人脉。 获得传说人脉后计数重置，概率恢复为基础概率。 3、【廷根旧梦】的保底次数会一直累积在限时结交活动中，与常驻结交活动独立计算互不影响。 4、限时结交活动每日可获得100次结交次数，最多可累计至700次。 <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/><Title>重复获得人脉</> 重复获得相同传说人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和10个投影片段。如果该传说人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为40个投影片段。 重复获得相同史诗人脉时，将转化为1个对应人脉提升材料和2个投影片段。如果该史诗人脉已经达到极致或材料足以提升至极致，多余的提升材料会转化为2个投影片段。 投影片段可用于在人脉商店兑换道具。
ref_en: [Tingen Old Dreams] is a limited-time Befriending Connections activity. During the activity, the Befriending probability of Klein Moretti is greatly increased. When you obtain a Legendary Connection, there is an 80% probability that it is Klein Moretti. If the Legendary Connection obtained this time is not Klein Moretti, the next Legendary Connection obtained is guaranteed to be Klein Moretti. Probability Information </> <Highlight> [Legendary] </> Quality Connection: Base probability is 1.5%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 3.74%. Includes: Klein Moretti, Audrey Hall, Leonard Mitchell, Fors Wall, Dunn Smith, Daly Simone, Alger Wilson. <Highlight> [Epic] </> Quality Connection: Base probability is 10%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 22.56%. Includes: Susie, Lovia Tiffany, Old Neil, Frye, Frank Lee, Benson Moretti, Melissa Moretti. <Highlight> [General Items] Related </>: Base probability is 88.5%, comprehensive probability (including pity) is 73.70%. Includes: Basic Materials, Aggregation Factors. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Befriending Details </> 1. Every 5 Befriending attempts, you are guaranteed to obtain a Connection of Epic quality or higher. 2. If you do not obtain a Legendary Connection in 24 consecutive Befriending attempts, the subsequent probability will gradually increase. You are guaranteed to obtain a Legendary Connection every 40 Befriending attempts. After obtaining a Legendary Connection, the count resets, and the probability returns to the base probability. 3. The pity count for [Tingen Old Dreams] will always accumulate in the limited-time Befriending activity and is calculated independently of the permanent Befriending activity, not affecting each other. 4. In the limited-time Befriending activity, you can obtain 100 Befriending attempts per day, which can be accumulated up to 700 times. <img id="Tips" width="30" height="46"/> <Title> Repeatedly Obtaining Connections </> When you repeatedly obtain the same Legendary Connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding Connection improvement material and 10 Projection Fragments. If that Legendary Connection has already reached the ultimate level or the materials are sufficient to upgrade it to the ultimate level, the excess improvement materials will be converted into 40 Projection Fragments. When you repeatedly obtain the same Epic Connection, it will be converted into 1 corresponding Connection improvement material and 2 Projection Fragments. If that Epic Connection has already reached the ultimate level or the materials are sufficient to upgrade it to the ultimate level, the excess improvement materials will be converted into 2 Projection Fragments. Projection Fragments can be used to exchange for items in the Connection Shop.

source_cn:
关于本品：
本品为针对灵体的专项封印器具，对怨灵、执念型恶灵及强负面灵性体均有显著效力。
价格不菲。效果对得起价格。


负面反应说明：
购入者注视镜面时，可能出现以下感受：
持续的"吸引感"，难以移开视线
无由来的落泪冲动
想要打破镜子的念头
以上均属正常。


使用方法
封印步骤：
对准目标
确保对方身影被镜面完整照到
保持照射，持续时间越长，封印效果越稳定
目标被完全封入镜中空间后，其灵性将被持续消耗、削弱，无法自行逃逸


终结步骤：
以魔镐敲击镜面，恶灵将被削弱力量后勾出，使用者可自行选择割喉亦或砍下其头部，使之被永久消灭。


静置与保管
不使用时，建议镜面朝内、背面朝外放置，或以厚布完全遮盖。


附：
请勿将其在无遮蔽状态下过夜放置。
若已如此放置，次日请检查镜框内侧银片。
若发现划痕——请确认划痕的方向。
若为由外向内，属正常磨损。
若为由里向外，请将镜面立即翻转，背面朝外，随后自行做仪式驱魔、净化处理。
ref_en:
About this item: 
 This is a specialized sealing tool for spirits, highly effective against wraiths, obsession-type evil spirits, and strong negative spiritual entities. 
 The price is not cheap. The effect is worth the price. 


 Negative Reaction Description: 
 When the purchaser gazes at the mirror surface, the following sensations may occur: 
 A continuous 'sense of attraction', making it difficult to look away 
 An inexplicable urge to weep 
 A thought of wanting to break the mirror 
 All of the above are normal. 


 Usage Method 
 Sealing Steps: 
 Aim at the target 
 Ensure the target's figure is fully reflected in the mirror 
 Maintain the reflection; the longer the duration, the more stable the sealing effect 
 Once the target is completely sealed into the mirror space, its spirituality will be continuously consumed and weakened, unable to escape on its own 


 Finishing Steps: 
 Strike the mirror surface with the magic pickaxe; the evil spirit will have its power weakened and be hooked out. The user can choose to slit its throat or decapitate it, causing it to be permanently eliminated. 


 Storage and Maintenance 
 When not in use, it is recommended to place it mirror-side in and back-side out, or cover it completely with a thick cloth. 


 Appendix: 
 Please do not leave it overnight in an uncovered state. 
 If it has been left this way, please check the silver foil on the inside of the mirror frame the next day. 
 If scratches are found - please confirm the direction of the scratches. 
 If from outside to inside, it is normal wear and tear. 
 If from inside to outside, please flip the mirror immediately, back-side out, and then perform a ritual exorcism and purification yourself.

source_cn:
比煤灰更厚重的黑夜里，唯有工厂区的酒馆保持着喧闹。
大笑、咳嗽、无休止的抱怨……巡警咒骂着，像避开麻烦一样绕过噪音，走向远处的街区。
“他们走了。”娜塔放下帘子，向清醒的人们宣告。
工人们正把布条铺在地上，用木炭条写着明天要举的口号：“要工资”“要休息”“要像人一样生活”，孩子挤在角落，分装干粮与小瓶酒精。烛火昏暗，映出一双双发亮的眼睛。
“等到明天，我们就能拿回应得的报酬了吗？”年长的工人问。
“等到明天，我们就能保证十小时的休息吗？”年幼的孩子问。
“……抱歉，我无法向你们担保。”娜塔沉默了。
 “我们的旗帜会倒下，但我们前进的每一步，都会在地上留下痕迹。”
或许，远在另一个时代，已经有人沿着它走到天亮。
ref_en:
In the night, thicker and heavier than coal dust, only the taverns in the factory district remained noisy. 
 Laughter, coughing, endless complaints... The patrolmen cursed, avoiding the noise as if avoiding trouble, and walked toward the distant blocks. 
 "They're gone." Nata lowered the curtain and announced to those who were awake. 
 The workers were laying cloth strips on the ground, using charcoal sticks to write the slogans they would hold up tomorrow: "We want wages," "We want rest," "We want to live like human beings." Children huddled in the corner, dividing dry rations and small bottles of alcohol. The candlelight was dim, reflecting pairs of bright eyes. 
 "By tomorrow, will we be able to get the pay we deserve?" an older worker asked. 
 "By tomorrow, will we be able to guarantee ten hours of rest?" a young child asked. 
 "...Sorry, I cannot guarantee that to you." Nata fell into silence. 
 "Our flag may fall, but every step we take forward will leave a mark on the ground." 
 Perhaps, far away in another era, someone has already followed it until dawn.

source_cn: 组队模式参加副本<Highlight>五月庄园·城堡（困难）</>，完成阶段<Highlight>子嗣守护</>后，可以参与公共掉落的分配与拍卖。有概率获得下列外观。
ref_en: Participating in the dungeon <Highlight>May Manor · Castle (Hard)</> in party mode and completing the stage <Highlight>Offspring Protection</> allows you to participate in the distribution and auction of public drops. There is a chance to obtain the following appearances.

source_cn: 罗勒牛尾汤，因蒂斯肥牛炖的罗勒牛尾汤。
ref_en: Basil oxtail soup, basil oxtail soup stewed with Intis fat beef.

source_cn: 罗珊之前说武器库在哪来着……下楼梯之后往右走？
ref_en: Where did Rozanne say the Armory was... go right after going down the stairs?

source_cn: 而且是完美的引路者和投资人！
ref_en: And a perfect guide and investor!

source_cn: 能感受到身体内的<P_Yellow>非凡力量</>吗？尝试掌控它！
ref_en: Can you feel the <P_Yellow> Beyonder power </> inside your body? Try to control it!

source_cn: 英雄-乌龟-冲撞标记tag-玩家头顶标记
ref_en: Hero - Turtle - Charge Mark Tag - Player Head Mark
Trigger - Step back a few steps

source_cn: 赋予队友<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="21">净化</>能力，持续6秒。\n期间内，队友击败敌方玩家时，短时间后将<HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="21">净化</>目标，该效果最多生效3次。
ref_en: Grants teammates the <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="21"> Purification </> ability for 6 seconds. \n During this time, when a teammate defeats an enemy player, they will <HyperLink stylename="M_Link" u="21"> Purify </> the target after a short delay; this effect can trigger up to 3 times.

source_cn: 近期在演出的只有《伯爵归来》一部戏……呵呵。
ref_en: The only play currently being performed is "The Count's Return"... Heh.

source_cn: 这么多计划？找不到就找不到！
ref_en: So many plans? If you can't find it, you can't find it!

source_cn: 这只母猫在我家门口叫了三天！全家人都被它打搅得睡不着觉。
ref_en: This female cat has been meowing at my door for three days! My whole family is so disturbed by it that we can't sleep.

source_cn: 除了魔药配置外，魔药房还是一个药剂讨论与交流的平台，感兴趣的话你可以和这里的学员交流交流，说不定会有所收获。
ref_en: In addition to potion preparation, the Potion Room is also a platform for potion discussion and exchange. If you are interested, you can communicate with the students here; you might gain something.

source_cn: <P_Heart>（伦纳德·米切尔，序列8的“午夜诗人”……他看起来很悠闲，得让他再去背几本诗集了。）</>
ref_en: <P_Heart> (Leonard Mitchell, a Sequence 8 "Midnight Poet"... he looks very relaxed, I'll have to make him memorize a few more poetry collections.) </>

source_cn: Marquis black tea has a long-lasting fragrance, a mild taste, and moderate acidity, most suitable for a {{先生|女士}} with excellent taste like you.
ref_en: Marquis black tea has a lingering fragrance, a mild flavor, and balanced acidity—perfect for a discerning {{sir|madam}} like you.

source_cn: Would you like to take a tour, {{先生|女士}}?

ref_en: [UIFrame : UIComponent].StopAnimation: stop animation failed, widgetAnimation = nil %s

source_cn: ……看来面对苦痛而无可奈何的命运，她也微笑着走了下去。
ref_en: ...It seems that she walked on with a smile even in the face of painful and helpless fate.

source_cn: 【完成主线·时代的浪潮，成为序列9后解锁，尝试扮演占卜家】\n霍纳奇斯花海，一位女士站在许愿树下，着急地四处张望着……
ref_en: 【Complete Main Quest: Waves of the Era, unlock after becoming Sequence 9, try acting as a Seer】 \n At the Hornacis Sea of Flowers, a lady stands under the wishing tree, looking around anxiously...

source_cn: 【完成主线·时代的浪潮，成为序列9后解锁，尝试扮演歌颂者】\n街角长椅上，年轻人的肩膀微微发抖。他面前摆着一束花和一封信，但手怎么都伸不出去。
ref_en: 【Complete Main Quest: Waves of the Era, unlock after becoming Sequence 9, try acting as a Bard】 \n On the street corner bench, the young man's shoulders are trembling slightly. He has a bouquet of flowers and a letter in front of him, but he can't bring himself to reach out.

source_cn: 一名童工被醉汉拦在街角，他们的争吵似乎愈演愈烈……
ref_en: A child laborer is stopped by a drunkard at the street corner; their argument seems to be intensifying...

source_cn: 不用顾忌我，拿出你的最大实力就好。
ref_en: Don't hold back for my sake, just show me your full strength.

source_cn: 亲爱的，为什么我记得罗塞尔大帝写过一样的诗？
ref_en: My dear, why do I remember Emperor Roselle writing the same poem?

source_cn: 他不是去继承家业了么，怎么回来了？
ref_en: Didn't he go to inherit the family business? Why is he back?

source_cn: 任务自定义事件  玩家发送任务道具  玩家播放仅自己可见的说话文本
ref_en: Quest custom event, player sends quest item, player plays speech text visible only to self

source_cn: 使用后获得<Highlight>头像·日落泳装</>
ref_en: Use to obtain <Highlight> Avatar: Sunset Swimwear </>

source_cn: 使用后获得称号:<Highlight>愚者的眷者</>
ref_en: After use, obtain the title: <Highlight>Blessed of the Fool</>

source_cn: 别提了……昨天我看到有两个流浪汉躺在这两张椅子上……
ref_en: Don't mention it... Yesterday I saw two homeless people lying on these two chairs...

source_cn: 北区教堂骑警巡逻路线
ref_en: North District Church Mounted Police Patrol Route

source_cn: 参与副本<Highlight>丰饶之树（普通）</>，击败<Highlight>西尔维娅</>后，有概率获得下列外观。
ref_en: Participate in the dungeon <Highlight>Tree of Abundance (Normal)</>. After defeating <Highlight>Sylvia</>, there is a chance to obtain the following appearances.

source_cn: 吉米，{{先生|女士}}……妈妈白天做女仆，晚上还要穿很冷的衣服出去跳舞。她说等攒够钱就送我去学徒。可是……可是警察说妈妈做了坏事……妈妈是坏人吗？
ref_en: Jimmy, {{ Mr. | Ms. }}... Mom works as a maid during the day and has to go out to dance in very cold clothes at night. She said she would send me to be an apprentice once she saved enough money. But... but the police said Mom did something bad... Is Mom a bad person?

source_cn: 听说塔罗牌只是罗塞尔大帝发明出来的游戏，其实并不具备占卜的功能？
ref_en: I heard that Tarot cards were just a game invented by Emperor Roselle and don't actually have the function of divination?

source_cn: 哈哈——看看你这副可怜的模样，真是滑稽。
ref_en: Haha—look at your pathetic state, it's truly comical.

source_cn: 嗯，这也是她给我喝下魔药的原因。
ref_en: Yeah, that's also the reason she made me drink the potion.
